what: The photos around the center title are linked in angular order by thin lines and hung like a clothesline. Each line sags by 8% of its length and always sways with wind waves (amplitude 10~19px × .35, 1.8~3.3 nodes, drifting .16~.34 turns per second). When the mouse passes within 60px of a line, that node is pushed in the direction it passed and swings like a spring (neighbor pull 640 · damping .55) before settling. Photos hang from the line ends with a ±3° base tilt, and on hover they tilt a further 6° toward the side the hand came from (.64s power2.out, .44s power3.out on release)

options.tilt: Base tilt range (deg) — ± value set by photo number, default 3
options.lean: Extra tilt angle on hover (deg), default 6
options.wave: Wind ripple strength multiplier, default 1 (at 0 only sag and hand sway remain)
options.sag: Sag ratio relative to line length, default .08
options.[data-fx-part=ropes]: SVG to draw the line on — the part creates one if missing

from.where: index.html .dc-story (ring of old photos around the big ”since 0000” title — original Home/History photos-grid: photos pinned at points on two rings, wind phase and strength random per line, spring 640·.55, tilt ±3° + 6° toward the pointer .64s/.44s)

note: The original pins photos to points on two rings, outer and inner (inner .7x), and draws lines from the ring point to the photo. The part links photos in angle order so it fits any layout
